scientific.integrity: The Yogi state map is evaluated exactly at every positive accumulator equilibrium. Because the second-moment increment is quadratic in the gradient, the accumulator is a neutral tangent direction and the normal spectrum is an explicit second-order polynomial.
limitations: The theorem is local, deterministic, scalar, and excludes bias correction, weight decay, and schedules.
The endpoint accumulator value zero is nonsmooth and is not assigned a differentiable local spectrum.
No claim is made that the default zero-accumulator trajectory converges to a positive accumulator level.
The full optimizer state has a neutral direction; the stability statement is normal/transverse, not asymptotic stability of an isolated fixed point.

title: Neutral accumulator manifold and exact transverse-stability threshold for Yogi
